reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2027
reviews_list.review_title: This is the best college in budget.

review_content.Placements: Between 60% to 70% of students in the B.Tech CSE program were placed, with an average salary package of 4 to 5 lakhs and the highest package reaching 1 crore. The top recruiting companies at my college include Microsoft, Amazon, Google, Paytm, and others. Internships are also exceptional, with students securing positions at renowned companies such as Accenture, Codsoft, Razorpay, and others. The primary roles offered to B.Tech CSE graduates include web developer, data analyst, and HR positions.
review_content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is awesome. Classrooms are good. We have labs. The library is the best. For hosteller students college also provides hygienic food, good rooms, and Wi-Fi is also available for us 24/7. Sports careers are also excellent in the VGU.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2027
reviews_list.review_title: Absolutely dissatisfied.

review_content.Placements: As we are the first batch of Sunstone from this college, I have no information about this. Neither do I know about the top recruiting companies. The top roles offered in my course are software developer, HR in a company, frontend and backend web developer, etc.
review_content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi doesn't work properly. We have to use our own net. The labs and classrooms are quite good. The quality of the hostel is very bad. Food is not at all good in the mess. Sports and games are held on our campus. The canteen food is good, but it is not hygienic.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2027
reviews_list.review_title: The college is all-around good but needs more improvement.

review_content.Placements: 50 percent students were placed from this course. Salary Packages: The highest package was 8 LPA. The lowest package was 5 LPA. The average package was 2 3 LPA. Top recruiting companies that recruited from this course include 1. Amazon 2. TCS 3. Tech Mahindra.
review_content.Infrastructure: Facilities and Infrastructure: 1. Wi-Fi: The department offers high-speed Wi-Fi in only some areas of the campus. Only the lab and some classes have Wi-Fi facilities. 2. Labs: The labs are not good enough. Some of them are working, and some have parts and software issues. 3. Classrooms: Some of the classes have projectors, and some do not. This does not make the class interesting.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Web Application - Batch of 2028
reviews_list.review_title: The college infrastructure is good, campus life is amazing and faculty members are so helpful.

review_content.Placements: The placement rate is good—about 70% of students placed per year—and they also provided internships to all students. And the highest package is about 33 lakh per annum and the average package is 2-3 lakh per annum. If you want to join this college with a low budget, then you can get admission in it.
review_content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of my college is good; the college campus is on 33 acres; it is a little bit smaller but the infrastructure of the college is too good and the hostel is also good and the mess is average. And in the whole college, Wi-Fi is available with full-speed internet.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Application Development - Batch of 2027
reviews_list.review_title: Reality of Vivekananda Global University.

review_content.Placements: Our college placement is really very good. Every year, thousands of students get placements. According to placement, an internship at VGU is very good. I actually don't know about correct no. of some students got placements but yes, I know thousands of students got placements. Sunstone also helps to give us an advantage in our degree and they especially give a chance of placement.
review_content.Infrastructure: Overall, if I talk about infrastructure, that is pretty good. Everything available in our university, like the library, sports grounds, mess, canteen, and medical facilities,. Everything is available at our university. If I talk about hostels, there are many, but on campus, there are only 4 hostels available, 1 for girls and the other 3 for boys. 1 hostel building is non-AC, and one is an AC building.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Full Stack Development - Batch of 2025
reviews_list.review_title: Overall, it is a good campus and conducts a lot of extracurricular activities.

review_content.Placements: B.Tech in Computer Science students comprise approximately 60 percent of the college population; the average package offered is 5 LP to 7 LP. The top companies are DotSquare, etc. Most of the students apply for internships on their own. The campus also conducts internship drives for students, which is a great opportunity.
review_content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of our college is overall good and has a very friendly environment. Our campus has 2 libraries with PCs available for self-study. All subjects' books are available in the library, and the whole campus has Wi-Fi facilities. Mess food is quite low quality but sometimes fine.

paragraphs: Vivekananda Global University (VGU) powered by Sunstone Admissionto all courses is entrance-based. The candidates are required to appear forSunstone Screening, which includes an Aptitude test and a Personal Interview round to secure a seat at theVGU powered by Sunstone.

Vivekananda Global University Powered by Sunstone courses are AICTE approved and the University is accredited by NAAC. The popular courses offered by VGU powered by Sunstone are BBA, MBA and BTech. More details around Vivekananda Global University Powered by Sunstone admission process are elaborated in the article below.

Admission to all theVGU powered by Sunstone coursesis entrance-based. Candidates, however, for all courses are required to meet minimum eligibility criteria to get shortlisted for any and every course offered by Vivekananda Global University (VGU) powered by Sunstone. Check below Vivekananda Global University (VGU) powered by Sunstone courses along with their eligibility and selection criteria:

Passed 10+2 examination with Physics/ Mathematics / Chemistry/ Computer Science/ Biology/ subjects from the following listbit.ly/4coGqWU. Agriculture stream (for Agriculture Engineering) Obtained at least 45% marks (40% marks for  SC/ST) in the above subjects taken together.

Vivekananda Global University (VGU) powered by Sunstone has a multi-step admission process that students need to follow to get into the university. Starting with the application, students are required to go through the course-specific entrance exam followed by other selection rounds (if applicable). After the selection rounds are over, course-wise merit lists are released on the official website (with the names of the shortlisted students) of the university, post which interested candidates can submit the fee and confirm their admission.
The step-wise VGU powered by Sunstone admission process is mentioned below:
Step 1: Application Process
The application process at VGU powered by Sunstone is completely online. Candidates can visit the official website at (sunstone.in/) to apply for UG and PG programmes.
Step 2: Selection Rounds

Admission to VGU powered by Sunstone is partially based on the performance of the candidates in the Sunstone Screening test (Test and interview) or entrance exam. Candidates who perform well are shortlisted for the personal interview round.Vivekananda Global University Powered by Sunstoneconducts the personal interview round to finalise the students for admission.
Step 3: Document verification
After the completion of the selection rounds, candidates must present the original copies of the documents uploaded during the application process.
Step 4: Seat Booking
Candidates who are selected during the selection rounds are required to pay the admission confirmation fee to secure their seats.

reviews.review_heading: This is the best college in budget.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is awesome. Classrooms are good. We have labs. The library is the best. For hosteller students college also provides hygienic food, good rooms, and Wi-Fi is also available for us 24/7. Sports careers are also excellent in the VGU.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely dissatisfied.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi doesn't work properly. We have to use our own net. The labs and classrooms are quite good. The quality of the hostel is very bad. Food is not at all good in the mess. Sports and games are held on our campus. The canteen food is good, but it is not hygienic.

reviews.review_heading: The college is all-around good but needs more improvement.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and Infrastructure: 1. Wi-Fi: The department offers high-speed Wi-Fi in only some areas of the campus. Only the lab and some classes have Wi-Fi facilities. 2. Labs: The labs are not good enough. Some of them are working, and some have parts and software issues. 3. Classrooms: Some of the classes have projectors, and some do not. This does not make the class interesting.

reviews.review_heading: The college infrastructure is good, campus life is amazing and faculty members are so helpful.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of my college is good; the college campus is on 33 acres; it is a little bit smaller but the infrastructure of the college is too good and the hostel is also good and the mess is average. And in the whole college, Wi-Fi is available with full-speed internet.

reviews.review_heading: Reality of Vivekananda Global University.
reviews.review_text: Overall, if I talk about infrastructure, that is pretty good. Everything available in our university, like the library, sports grounds, mess, canteen, and medical facilities,. Everything is available at our university. If I talk about hostels, there are many, but on campus, there are only 4 hostels available, 1 for girls and the other 3 for boys. 1 hostel building is non-AC, and one is an AC building.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, it is a good campus and conducts a lot of extracurricular activities.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is overall good and has a very friendly environment. Our campus has 2 libraries with PCs available for self-study. All subjects' books are available in the library, and the whole campus has Wi-Fi facilities. Mess food is quite low quality but sometimes fine.

reviews.review_heading: My experience at Vivekananda Global University.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of this university is okay and the classrooms are good too. The college provides free Wi-Fi and labs are maintained as well. The food in the hostel is not so good but okay. The canteen offers so many things to try, and the medical facilities are good.

reviews.review_heading: My experience in Vivekananda Global University.
reviews.review_text: Great infrastructure, and the classrooms are good too. Separate labs for computer classes and Linux classes as well as for DBMS. The college is provided with a Wi-Fi network with moderate speed. Hostels are good, and the canteen offers so many things to eat, and you can play many things there too.

reviews.review_heading: A Fun Filled University Experience At Vivekananda Global University .
reviews.review_text: The facilities are higher than any other university. Whole campus is Wi-Fi source, classrooms are comfortable and large with projector in every room, it is also a NAAC A+ rated institute which is very rare! There are 2 central libraries where you can find books for every domain and subject and even novels ans spiritual books. Fiction s and Science, comedy and romance every book is available and can be issue for free. You can even order books if required. There are multiple hostels for both boys ...

reviews.review_heading: MBA in Vgu- satisfied with the campus life.
reviews.review_text: We have facilities like a library, nice classrooms, and a canteen facility. I don't like hostel facilities because the food quality is not good and the wardens are not friendly. If we don't have class any day, she still says to go out of the hostel even though we don't have class.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Vivekanand Global University Sunstone.
reviews.review_text: No Wi-Fi, classes are good, labs are average, and the library is average. The hostel's food quality is below average. Medical facilities are good, but the canteen food is so expensive.

reviews.review_heading: I want to say that my college is average. Students improve their skills and become self-independent.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure available for my course are good. For example, there are separate labs for separate departments, like robotics and computer science labs for engineering students. There is also facility of Wi-Fi facility, water cooler, central library, and the quality of food in mess is average. There is also a separate ground for sports.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: The college is too worst, it will take money and all the time and make us search for our own job.

content.Placements: The placements in the college are too bad, when the placement officer is there but not helpful. If the placement is there, it is only for publicity, and after some days the job becomes so hard to get that one has to resign to it, and it is further helpful for next time.
content.Infrastructure: There is no infrastructure and facilities for the students; it is so the worst. We have to adjust to the classroom without fan, proper windows, computers, and all. It is nicely painted from outside to attract new admissions. There is no hostel attached to the college.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: College is absolutely not good to choose for study.

content.Placements: College is good. Most of the students are placed in different multinational companies. The percentage of required students in placement is 65%. The higher package is 12 LPA, and lowest is 5 LPA. The internships are very low within the college. There is no internship here.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure on the campus is not good, but it is set up as good to attract new admissions. The toilets are not cleaned. If it is cleaned again, it smells badly. The materials in the lab are only for decorative purposes, they don't work properly. There is no hostel at the college, and students stay at nearly PGs.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: The college is absolutely good because of its best nature.

content.Placements: I joined the brilliant institute by hearing the fame, and after the percentage of students was placed at 65%. Nearly 80 members per annum are recruited by the top companies from across Hyderabad city. The internship factor may be less, but the package was good, nearly 7-10 LPA.
content.Infrastructure: The facilities are average in the institute rather than well campus, but here is the present nature far away from Hyderabad city. The labs and departments are on separate floors, the labs are only for looking purpose. There is no hostel attached to the college, but the students come from Hyderabad.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: The college is best to enjoy, the worst to study.

content.Placements: I'm presently studying in this college, mostly the college is the best in exam pass percentage, and that is more than 65% which is impossible with other colleges. Some companies come to recruit, but not most. The internship is not with other than the CSE allied branches.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure on the campus is not in good condition, it is not situated where it is supposed to be, and the fans and lights are not under maintenance. The washrooms are not cleaned, and the major problem is with the drinking water. The hostel is not attached to the college, and there is no particular hostel associated with the college.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: College is best for those who want to enjoy but average for study.

content.Placements: College is absolutely okay and fine. The placements are just okay. The package is nearly 6 LPA. Internships are not from the side of the college. There is no internship program for Brilliant College. There may be some companies that come to college to hire students for placements. The percentage of students who get internships is nearly 20 to 30%. The highest package is 40 LPA, lowest is 3 LPA, and the average package is 6 LPA.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is not good. The benches are rarely damaged. There is no insufficient water for drinking. The canteen is beside the college, but there is no such good food at other high prices. The facility is available for sports. At the present time, the faculty is also there for sports. Every time we have to go to study in library, and it is so good. There is no hostel for the college. We have to travel some distance to go to hostel. It is the nearest villages and they are private.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Computer Application (BCA) - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Honest review of Jaypee University, Anoopshahr.

content.Placements: Placement is average; many students are placed in sales companies even though they belong to the CS department or are teaching students. The average package is 12 LPA, and the highest was 32 LPA. Many students from our college are placed, and if some are not, it means they either want to do a master's or don't want a job.
content.Infrastructure: Talking about infrastructure, it's quite good. The course department, labs, classrooms, and library are well maintained, and the placements are nearby and clean, as the university is located on the bank of the holy river Ganga. This enhances the beauty and scenery of the university, creating a peaceful and calm atmosphere. Hostels are well maintained, and the food is healthy and delicious. The university also provides sports and games facilities.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Computer Application (BCA) - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: I am averagely satisfied with the placement.

content.Placements: During the admission procedure for our course, we were informed that 90% of students are placed from our college. As a first-year student, I haven't seen many senior students placed but the process of placement usually takes place at particular intervals. Placements are provided in our college, but it usually depends on our CGPA. The highest salary package offered is 32 LPA. The average salary package offered is between 4-5 LPA. Many companies like Amazon and Genpact visit our university for placement opportunities. I highly recommend focusing more on off-campus placements, if someone is willing to take admission in this university. Many summer internships are also provided to the B.Tech students. There are more opportunities and offers for the B.Tech course compared to the other relevant courses.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Our college provides us every facility which is good enough for us.

content.Placements: Around 50% of students got placed in our college. The highest salary package offered was 32 LPA. The lowest salary package offered was 6 LPA. Top recruiting companies are HCL, Amazon, and TCS. Almost 60% of students got internships in our college from this course in the best companies.
content.Infrastructure: Our college provides us with the best facilities in each department. We have good computer labs. All students can perform practicals on their laptops. Wi-Fi is available in computer labs. Our canteen provides the best quality of food for their students.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com. Hons.) - Batch of 2020
individual_reviews.title: reviews of Jaypee University, Anoopshahr.

content.Placements: Almost 60% of students are placed at our college. The average salary package offered was 3.4 LPA. Amazon is a top recruiting company that visited our college campus. Sharekhan is a company where our college students were selected for internships. Our college provides good placements for all students. But if a student does not give a proper interview, then college is not responsible for this.
content.Infrastructure: Most games are available at our college and we have a good faculty. College dean was good. Wi-Fi facility is available. The best thing is that this university is near Kashi (Ganga). A good library and sports grounds are available on our campus.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com. Hons.) - Batch of 2020
individual_reviews.title: Our institution provided better education and maintained discipline.

content.Placements: Our college is very good for students who are well-knowledgeable. It is better for placements of students at a higher level and well-developed companies. Our batch got placed in various companies like Amazon, Wipro, etc. Top-rated recruitment is done by Wipro. The highest salary package offered is 19.7 LPA, the average salary package offered is 7 LPA, and the lowest salary package offered is 3.5 LPA.
content.Infrastructure: In our college, good facilities are available like good infrastructure, Wi-Fi, well-prepared labs, a well-maintained library and smart classrooms. The quality of food available in the mess is excellent. Medical and sports facilities are also available.

reviews.review_heading: There is the best environment and facilities.
reviews.review_text: There were Wi-Fi and labs facilities. Moreover, there was a field for practicals. Facilities in the hostel are extremely good, but the problem is we need to adjust to the food. There were enough medical facilities for us and a canteen and a ground for games and sports. There was a special week for only sports and games in a month.

reviews.review_heading: My experience in 2017-21.
reviews.review_text:
Infrastructure is good in agricultural engineering.
But faculty is not enough in numbers.
Hostel is also good but there is also issue of food in hostel.
Labs are also not that good. 
So if you want to study here you have to learn from any other place like training place.

reviews.review_heading: I am disappointed because there are no qualified teachers.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is available only for staff but in hostel, students can use Wi-Fi. But very slow speed. Library is available for all students. But 100 INR are charged to get library pass. Canteen is good. Medical facility was average. No sport equipment is provided by the college.

reviews.review_heading: I love our Bhagwant University.
reviews.review_text: Our college has a high infrastructure, many blocks, many classrooms and labs. There are a huge gallery and a huge lush green area. Our hostels are huge, and the warden is very good because he helps. Overall, I love my college life, and I missed it very much.

reviews.review_heading: I am not satisfied with the college.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is good. The campus is huge, including all facilities. The college provides all laboratories like a chemistry lab, physics lab and bio lab with all necessary equipment. Sports facilities are also available, and also many sports competitions are organised by the college. Food served in the canteen is good. The canteen is clean, good and spacious.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Bhagwant University Ajmer (BUA).
reviews.review_text: University provides all sorts of resources for an ideal student who wants to gain knowledge and skills. Library, labs, canteen, gym hall, sports facilities, etc., are available on the campus. The building has a lift for disabled students. Gym hall has all the equipment, which is needed to maintain fitness. Sports teacher is available if you are interested in any games. For academic excellence, teachers are available for 24x7 coaching.

reviews.review_heading: I'm fully satisfied with our university and also with our faculty for a better future.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our university is quite good enough, and it looks beautiful. I also love my college. Infrastructure is also very much important for the new students who come to take admission. If the infrastructure is not good, then students can reject and may not take the admission.

reviews.review_heading: All of than it is a wonderful college.
reviews.review_text: The college faculty members are good. All of them are well-experienced. individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering (Data Science) - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: I have a very good experience to share in this review.

content.Placements: In the case of Data Science, there are 60 students. 20-30% of students were selected for placements. The highest package is 20 Lacs. The lowest package is 3 Lacs. The available companies for internships are Amazon, Airtel, Infosys, Genpact, etc.
content.Infrastructure: In our college, the classrooms are not that great. In the library, there are many books which are helpful for higher studies. But the library is not that much good. I am not a hosteler; I am a day scholar. But my friends are in the hostel.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: College is really decent at everything; campus placement is really poor.

content.Placements: Just 3 students were placed out of around 56 students; I am talking about super seniors. The highest was maybe 3.5 LPA, though I am not sure, heard it from staff. Startups mostly, I never heard of their names. Around 15 out of 56 full-stack developers mostly.
content.Infrastructure: Decent infrastructure, students don't have access to Wi-Fi. Labs are okay, not that bad. Classrooms and library are decent and comfortable. I am not a hosteler, but I have gone there a few times; toilets are horrible, can't use. And campus is decent, very decent.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Review of Impact college.

content.Placements: The placement percentage of this college is about 87 percent. The highest package offered is 17 LPA, the lowest package is 7 LPA and the average package is 6 LPA. Around 77 percent of students in our course got internships in MNCs.
content.Infrastructure: The facilities and infrastructure were very good, and they provided a good environment on campus. The quality of the facilities in the college hostel was very good. However, the quality of the food available in the mess/canteen was not good.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: We have satisfied with your course and college with infrastructure in your college.

content.Placements: 70 percent of students were placed in your college. The highest package in your college and course is 20 Lacs per annum and the lowest package is offered by small-scale jobs. The top recruiting companies are Tata, HP Software Developer, Dell, IBM, and many more. We got 60 percent of internship opportunities from the company.
content.Infrastructure: The facilities are Wi-Fi with high speed and smart TVs for all classrooms. For the Department of Technology, we have high expectations for labs and the library. We have hostel facilities available for your college and good. And the canteen was available with good food facilities. We connected sports and games in your course and college with all games.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Good environment, and good teaching, especially math teacher.

content.Placements: The percentage of placement is not that good, but education is good. The lowest package is INR 4 Lacs per year, and the highest may be INR 8 Lacs per year. Infosys, Cafe Coffee Day, Accenture, etc. visit for recruitment. In these companies, we get good offers and roles. I am just in my first year, and I am expecting more from my college. I hope our days will be good.
content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is there, classrooms are good, and labs are okay. The library is good. We have a canteen, a cafe, and hygienic food. Labs should be improved, but otherwise everything is okay. Classrooms also have to be improved more. During rainy seasons, it becomes the worst.

reviews.review_heading: RKGITM has good placements and the best infrastructure and facilities.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, and the library are very good in RKGITM. Different types of labs are available, such as electrical engineering, mechanical engineering workshop lab, chemistry lab, physics lab, and python lab, all with full air conditioning in labs and classrooms. The hostel quality is good, and the rooms are better. The canteen food is much better. In sports, cricket, football, and hockey are among the many games played by students from the college.

reviews.review_heading: Good faculty members and campus. Fee is affordable.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is good. Wi-Fi and labs are up to date, and classrooms are neat and clean. Library is very good and book bank is issued semester-wise to each student. Quality of food is average but hygienic. Medical services are available 24X7.

reviews.review_heading: It's not worth your hard-earned money, average college, poor industry preparation, zero placement.
reviews.review_text: For the course and department infrastructure, there was Wi-Fi facility available in the hostel. Some classrooms had air conditioning, but not all. Labs were available, though there was usually only one AC in the entire lab. Computers were quite old but still functional. As for the hostel, facilities were average. The food quality in the mess and canteen was okay but not great. The medical facilities were limited, and sports/games options were basic.

reviews.review_heading: The college is good in terms of sllege is good interms of studies but in terms of skills it lacks.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is not available, and labs are not fully equipped with advanced facilities. The library seating capacity is very low. The hostel living area is average, and sports and games are organized regularly on campus. The food is not up to the mark, according to what I’ve heard from my hostel friends.

reviews.review_heading:
College is good but the campus is not that big.
They need to maximize the area a bit.
reviews.review_text:
Hostel and classrooms are good. 
The college has a good range Wi-Fi connection, and everyone has access to Wi-Fi at the hostel.
The food of the mess is quite good and tasty.
They provide food 4 times a day according to the menu suggested by the students.
Everything is good.

reviews.review_heading: Our college life at RKGITM .
reviews.review_text: Every department has a separate building assigned to it; each classroom contains a smart class monitor and air conditioning. The labs are provided with good computers that have pre-installed software that we might need to use. The library also has a digital room.

reviews.review_heading: Best college in Delhi NCR.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure of our college are decent; all classrooms are decent and air conditioned and the lab also air-conditioned. The whole campus is Wi-Fi enabled and the library also air-conditioned. The quality of food available in our hostel is decent.

reviews.review_heading: Good place near metro station.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is not as expected, but it has decent facilities and good staff. The hostel provides Wi-Fi facilities and is clean. The labs are not as good as expected, so we have to manage with limited resources. Food is nice college have a canteen decent rate games ground available.

reviews.review_heading: The best college for me.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is good and decent, with good facilities and a warden at all hostels. Wardens are strict and careful; if you are not going to college, they may ask you why you cannot go to college. All hostels have Wi-Fi facilities, good food, and medical facilities.

reviews.review_heading: It is the best college for students.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are very good. The infrastructure is decent. Classrooms are air-conditioned. Mess is also available. Our campus is Wi-Fi enabled. The food served in the canteen is average. Medical facilities are available. Sports are conducted in this college.

reviews.review_heading: I would recommend students to join this college.
reviews.review_text: Our college provides one of the best facilities in the NCR region. Our department is air-conditioned. Hostels are better. The food served in the hostel is very good. The cafeteria is available in our college. Medical facilities are available 24X7. Sports are conducted in our college. We also have a gym facility in our hostels.

reviews.review_heading: The infrastructure of college is not as much as I expected. But 2022 batch placement was good.
reviews.review_text: The overall facility and infrastructure are average. Wi-Fi facility is only available for the hostel and the library is average. The hostel is really good, the room is very spacious and after a few days, it will feel like home. You can take the facility of sports in the hostels.

reviews.review_heading: It is the best college with good placements.
reviews.review_text: Food served is good in the evening and tasty on Sunday.

reviews.review_heading: Our college provides opportunities in various fields.
reviews.review_text: Our college had excellent infrastructure. We had average labs. The hostel facilities were excellent. In comparison to other hostels, their rooms are very spacious. The hostel facilities are excellent for students. The meal is good and the security fee is Rs.20,000.

reviews.review_heading: It is a decent college, and the education level is good.
reviews.review_text: Our campus has 27 acres of land. It provides a variety of infrastructure resources to aid in its entire development. There are many services in this college.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2023Offered by College of Agriculture, Bijapur - University of Agricultural Sciences, DharwadReviewed on 9 Mar 2025)
reviews.review_heading: College of Agriculture Vijayapura is the best college and it has value for money.
reviews.review_text: When it comes to the infrastructure, it is not up to the mark. Roads and hostel rooms are not proper to use. The gym facilities are not there. Sports facilities are good. There is a sports teacher. The overall infrastructure and facilities of the colleges are not up to mark.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2023Offered by College of Agriculture, Bijapur - University of Agricultural Sciences, DharwadReviewed on 9 Mar 2025)
reviews.review_heading: College of Agriculture, Vijayapura.
reviews.review_text: Facilities at the hostel were good. There were 2 girls hostels and 3 boys hostels. Rooms were well-equipped with beds, cupboards, windows, and attached washrooms. Mess food was good but not great. There was no canteen in the college, but there was an emergency hospital available. Sports facilities were also available.

reviews.review_heading: The price structure and study are very good on this campus, and all facilities are good.
reviews.review_text: Bank price texture and the facility are good in this university. Like a classroom, ability and AC are also available. Equipments like these are also available in the boys’ hostel. Foods are good in the canteen. Also, outdoor and indoor sports are also available with guidance .

reviews.batch: Batch of 2026Offered by College of Agriculture, Bijapur - University of Agricultural Sciences, DharwadReviewed on 7 Nov 2024)
reviews.review_heading: An average college with less exposure.
reviews.review_text: The hostel facilities are very bad, and there is no Wi-Fi available in the hostel and college for students. The washrooms are common washrooms, and the food quality is also very bad. They are not providing any good food, including non-vegetarian food. There is no canteen in this college, and the sports facilities are okay—not that much good, but it’s better compared to others. The gym in the college doesn’t have any good facilities.

reviews.review_heading: Not satisfied completely, but still so much is there to explore. Good environment and good teaching.
reviews.review_text: We have a 24-hour Wi-Fi facility. Good labs with good infrastructure, digital classrooms, and good library facilities. In hostels, we have the facilities of Wi-Fi, good rooms, and healthy food. The canteen facility was good. For playing, we have both an outdoor and indoor stadium and a gym facility. We have a medical clinic in college.

reviews.review_heading: One of the best agricultural university in the world.
reviews.review_text: There is a very neatly and wisely arranged and constructed library consists lot of agriculture related books which help students to refer them. There is a Wi-Fi availability in library and hostel which also helps students to go through the online knowledge.

reviews.review_heading: Better college to study agriculture.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is good. Hostel facilities are good; they provide free Wi-Fi in both the hostel and the college. And the food is also good. We have to adjust; that's it. Hostel fees are around 2500 to 3000 per month. Overall, hostel facilities are good to tell and experience.

reviews.review_heading: Presently, it is an average college with good opportunities and campus life.
reviews.review_text: The infra is planned and good. But the hostel is a little complicated. Courses are little different than other universities but they are helpful in studies. Sometimes the syllabus gets finished while sometimes not. Hostel facilities are not bad.

reviews.review_heading: Happiness is great on campus.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is good but the hostel is poor. The food is good. Some students complain that the food is not good but if they go outside this campus, they realise how other college hostels are. We have good food served in our hostel than any other student.

reviews.review_heading: Our college is the top in India with good looking campus.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is good and the hostel is also great. Facilities are very good like the library and digital projector. Even classrooms are also good. There is a separate playground for cricket, kabaddi, and volleyball in the hostel. Hostel food is not bad. There are 2 study centers in the hostel.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with its teaching staff.
reviews.review_text: Our college and hostel infrastructure is good. In the hostel 24X7 water supply is available, and clean mineral drinking water is also provided. Hostel and mess are cleaned once in 2 to 3 days. The mess is hygienic and clean, and the student gets a variety of food every day.

reviews.review_heading: Our college is absolutely the best.
reviews.review_text: College and hostel have Wi-Fi facility, well-equipped labs, quality of food is good and average mess bill. One van is available 24x7 for medical emergency. There is large ground at entrance. All type of games are played in that ground.

reviews.review_heading: One of the best colleges in India. If you get admission here, don't miss the opportunity.
reviews.review_text: Our college has a good Wi-Fi network throughout the college campus, including the library, departments, and hostels. Labs are well-stocked with materials, and classrooms are equipped with smartboards and projectors. We have a large, two-story library on campus, as well as two study centres. The hostel is good for food and accommodation. The college has a volleyball court and a basketball court.

reviews.review_heading: Super college, don't miss your college life if you get admission in this college.
reviews.review_text: Our college is having beautiful facilities. In hostels, library we have Wi-Fi and lavs are good, classrooms are very good and vast with 60 students and for practical classes, only 30 students are there so there is good scope for learning and study. We will have a hostel day feast every month in a hostel where special food is done.

reviews.review_heading: Our college has experienced faculty and the availability of fields for research.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms on our campus have facilities like smart class teaching. The labs in our college have sophisticated equipment which is mandatory for each subject. Our library is accommodated with Wi-Fi and there are many books, including competitive subjects, that are also available. Our hostel in our college has good Wi-Fi facilities. We have a good canteen with good quality food.

paragraphs: Seacom Group of Colleges admissionis both merit and entrance-based. The college offers several programmes at undergraduate and postgraduate levels in the fields of Engineering, Education, Computer Application and more. To get a seat in any of the offered courses, students are required to satisfy the admission criteria of the desired course. The college accepts several national and state-level entrance tests, such as JEE Mains and WBJEE. Interested students can read the following article to know all about the courses, eligibility, selection criteria, and admission process forSeacom Group of Colleges.

Seacom Group of Colleges course admissionis made on the basis of preset admission criteria. Students looking to join the UG courses need to pass Class 12 or equivalent, whereas PG admissions require students to complete graduation from a recognised university. In addition to clearing the basic eligibility, students must also provide valid entrance exam scores. Find below the eligibility and selection criteria for popularSeacom Group of Colleges:

The admission process for Seacom Group of Colleges includes several steps from application to selection followed by admission confirmation. Students can apply online for the desired programme by registering themselves. Before applying, students must make sure that they fulfil the admission criteria as specified by the college. Eligible students can follow the steps explained below to complete theSeacom Group of Colleges admission process:
Step 1: Application Process

Interested students can apply online by visiting the official website of the college and filling out the application form. Students need to provide the required information and documents to complete the process.
Step 2: Selection Process

Students are mainly selected based on entrance exam scores. However for courses, such as B.Ed and D.El.Ed, students are selected based on merit in the last qualifying exam. For the remaining courses, candidates need to provide valid scores obtained in the accepted exams, such as JEE Main, WBJEE, JECA, etc.
Step 3: Admission Confirmation
Selected students need to pay the admission fees of the college to secure their seats.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Affordable college with good learning and campus life.

content.Placements: Our passing out batch got good results. About 60-65% of students are placed, with packages starting from 25,000. Ashok Leyland is the main company, and many got roles as supervisors and operators. Currently, the college is trying to bring other companies through collaboration with AESTHETIX EDU-TECH.
content.Infrastructure: Our college has campus Wi-Fi and labs, which are medium good for studying. Classrooms have projectors, and there is a library with textbooks, other study materials, and storybooks. Hostel food is adjustable. A small shop is in the hostel. But there is no medical facility in the hostel. In college, we have sports and games.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science Engineering - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Absolutely dissatisfied because of faculty, really good infrastructure and facilities.

content.Placements: 70% of students are placed. The highest package was about 5 LPA. Intern roles in companies are the most offered. Around 70% of students got internships from my course. Mega campus placements always take place on my campus. It is a good opportunity for students to get the job they need.
content.Infrastructure: Everything is okay with both the college and the hostel. But college didn't have a mess. The food provided in the hostel is bad. The atmosphere for studying is not at all good at the hostel. Because there are different types of students from different courses at the same hostel, they are all cloud people, which makes for an awful environment for studying.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Absolutely satisfied by the workings of the college and the behavior of the faculty.

content.Placements: The college has a well-functioning placement cell. They provide and conduct programs and seminars for the students to improve their skills and personalities, and they help them build inner confidence to interfere in interviews and acquire well-defined positions in a company.
content.Infrastructure: The classrooms are really spacious and have a conducive environment. Our college possesses good aesthetics and peaceful behavior. All high-tech instruments are available. The library is full of top-rated text books. Hostels are clean and have good daily maintenance.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning) - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Affordable fees, good teachers, useful curriculum, and decent placements.

content.Placements: In my course, 60% of students got placed, with salaries between Rs. 20,000 and Rs. 38,000 per month. TCS and Infosys were the main recruiters, and 50-70% got internships, mostly with Luminar. The top roles offered are software engineer and web developer. You can do internships all year.
content.Infrastructure: Campus Wi-Fi is available, a library full of books, and classrooms that are good but average. The hostel has a mess hall with food. The hostel fee is Rs. 6000 per month. There are no medical facilities, but sports and games are available on campus.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: It has a good campus life and atmosphere.

content.Placements: In our college till this year, no campus placements happened for the computer science department. But there are placements for other departments. We have to find internships ourselves and go for it. But from this year, they have signed an MOU with another company, and they are trying to bring other top companies to our campus for internships and placements.
content.Infrastructure: Facilities are good but not excellent. We have many labs, smart classrooms, campus Wi-Fi, and AC in the seminar hall, which is nice. There is a small canteen and store. The library is good for storybooks and syllabus-related books. In the hostel, we have a TV, Wi-Fi, and it is a 3-floor building with many rooms. Each room has at least 2 fans. There are no restrictions on mobile phones or laptops. Food quality is not good some days, but it's okay to adjust. There are no medical facilities in the hostel. We do have sports and games in college.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: The college is nice for this program and very affordable.

content.Placements: 75-80% of students get placed in our course. The highest package offered in this course ranges from 7-8 LPA. The minimum package ranges from 3-4 LPA. Top recruiting companies in this course are HCL, Wipro, TCS, Cognizant, etc. 60-70% of students got internships from our course in Wipro and other tech companies. The top roles offered in this course are software developer and app developer.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of this college is average. Wi-Fi is not working properly. Labs and chairs are not comfortable. The library is nice. Classrooms are not perfect. The hostel has all facilities like AC and Wi-Fi. Medical facilities are also available. In sports, they concentrate on volleyball. Indoor games are not available.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: Absolutely satisfied by the placement facility provided by my college.

content.Placements: My batch had a good placement record, with 85-90 percent of students getting jobs on campus. The highest salary offered was 7 LPA, the average was 3.5 LPA and the lowest was 1.8 LPA. Many core and non-core companies such as TCS, Wipro, Appinventive, Cloud Analogy, Grapecity, Hike Education, and WebKull, visited our college for placements. In addition, 60-70% of students got internships in various domains from various companies. The roles offered included data analyst, SDE, and technical recruiter.
content.Infrastructure: The college infrastructure is upto the mark. The labs are well maintained and have all the necessary equipment. The classrooms are quite big and can accommodate the entire class. There is a central library and departmental libraries in the college that have a wide variety of books in every discipline.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: College is very good. Campus life is good.

content.Placements: I am in the B.Tech mechanical branch at BIT College Meerut. The placement drive team is not working well. The average salary package offered is 3.6 LPA. The highest salary package offered is 6 LPA. The lowest salary package offered is 2.4 LPA. Not many companies do not visit our college.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is very good. There are 9-10 buildings. Each course has a separate building. Hostel facilities and rooms are very good. There is Wi-Fi and an entertainment room. The mess is very good. Food quality is very good.

content.Infrastructure: The classroom have the projectors and our classes will also be done on projectors and the classes of developing our personality will also run. individual_reviews.title: The college is good. The bad thing about college is the bad behavior of the guard.

faqs.question: How are M.Tech placements at National Institute of Electronics and Information Technology Gorakhpur?
faqs.answer: At NIELIT Gorakhpur, the placement rate for M.Tech graduates typically falls between 60% and 70%. This fluctuates a little based on the particular programme and demand in the sector.Several IT and electronics companies, as well as TCS, Infosys, Wipro, HCL, IBM, Accenture, and Cognizant, have claimed some successful placements. At NIELIT Gorakhpur, M.Tech graduates usually receive compensation packages that vary from 3 to 4.5 LPA on average. Although it's not as good as the best engineering schools in the area, this is still regarded as respectable and could be a fantastic place to start your career. The need for particular knowledge and abilities in the electronics and IT sectors at the moment affects placements.

college_info.college_name: NIELIT Gorakhpur Scholarship Details

paragraphs: Candidates need to pay a non-refundable application fee of INR 1,000 to apply for National Institute of Electronics and Information Technology Gorakhpur M.Tech programme. Aspirants can pay the fee via any of the online payment mode. Candidates have to register online through ORP for M.Tech programme.

Undergraduate (UG), Postgraduate (PG), Advanced Diploma, Certificate, and Diploma programmes are just a few of the many courses that NIELIT provides at various levels. The kind and difficulty of the course have a big impact on the cost. Depending on the length and subject matter of the course, fees normally range from Rs. 1,000 to Rs. 30,000. Depending on the length and complexity of the programme, fees can range from Rs. 30,000 to Rs. 60,000 for the whole thing.

Although NIELIT doesn't normally provide standard UG programmes like B.Tech, their equivalent Diploma programmes may cost between Rs. 30,000 and Rs. 60,000. The full cost of an M.Tech programme, which lasts two years, is fixed at Rs. 1.28 lakh. Additional fees are not included in this.
